query:
UPDATE requests r SET state = 'completed', response_status = 200,
                   response_body = '{"n":' || o.rn || '}',
                   completed_at = NOW() - (10 - o.rn) * INTERVAL '1 second'
            FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn
                  FROM requests WHERE batch_id = $1) o
            WHERE r.id = o.id
